title: Isolation of Mononuclear Cells Using SepMate
author: Ajit N Shah
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.88chzsw
materials: PMBC are ready for downstream process.

steps.title: Add density gradient medium
steps.instruction: Pipette the required volume of density gradient medium through the central hole of the SepMate™ insert so that the medium sits above the insert; small bubbles may form but do not affect performance.

steps.title: Dilute sample 1:1
steps.instruction: Mix the sample with an equal volume of PBS containing 2 % FBS (e.g., 5 mL sample + 5 mL PBS + 2 % FBS) and mix gently.

steps.title: Add diluted sample
steps.instruction: Keep the SepMate™ tube vertical and slowly pipette the diluted sample down the side of the tube (do not pour through the central hole) so it layers above the density gradient medium.

steps.title: Collect enriched MNC layer
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, collect the top layer containing the enriched mononuclear cells into a new tube; do not hold the SepMate™ tube inverted for more than 2 seconds. Residual RBCs on the insert surface do not affect performance.

substeps.instruction: Pour the top layer into a new tube (max 2 s inverted).
Optionally pipette off supernatant above the MNC layer to reduce platelet contamination.

steps.title: First wash of MNCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the collected cells in PBS + 2 % FBS and centrifuge at 300 × g for 8 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: ACK lysis of residual RBCs
steps.instruction: Perform ACK lysis, then wash and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add ACK lysis buffer and incubate for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final wash of MNCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in PBS + 2 % FBS and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend and count cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell pellet in the desired volume of media or buffer and perform a cell count.
